gaps.lead: The committee probably won't change the rules.
gaps.sentence: ___ the committee will change the rules.
gaps.explanation: probably won't = it is (highly) unlikely that.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle criticises a past decision.

gaps.lead: At no time did we think that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.sentence: It ___ that Pedro might be planning to leave the country.
gaps.hint: it occurred to sb = sb thought
gaps.explanation: 'At no time did we think' becomes 'it never occurred to us'.

gaps.lead: The soup needed a little more salt.
gaps.explanation: needed a little more = didn't have enough (salt).

gaps.lead: 'We are closing the factory,' the board announced.
gaps.sentence: The board announced that ___ the factory.
gaps.explanation: we → they; present continuous → past continuous: they were closing.

gaps.lead: She was made to wait for two hours.
gaps.explanation: 'Was made to wait' has the same meaning as 'had to wait'.
